findings.vulnerability: Plain text passwords in the authentication process.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that passwords are hashed properly before being stored.

findings.vulnerability: Assumes unique mobile numbers which can lead to incorrect authentication.
findings.recommendation: Implement checks to validate mobile numbers are unique.

findings.vulnerability: Generic error messages can improve brute force attack chances.
findings.recommendation: Use generic error messages to obfuscate valid users.

findings.vulnerability: Access tokens are generated without expiration conditions.
findings.recommendation: Include token expiration and validation to prevent replay attacks.

findings.vulnerability: Utilizing username input directly can allow injection attacks.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize and validate all inputs to prevent injection attacks.
